quests.title: Entrepreneur Simulator Challenge
quests.description: Start and manage your own virtual business empire!

story.introduction: You have ₹1 lakh to start your business! Make smart decisions to build a successful enterprise.

steps.title: Creating Your Business Plan
steps.narrative: The Business Mentor asks you to choose the best business structure for your startup.

problem.question: For a small tech startup with 2 founders, which business form would be most suitable?
problem.explanation: Partnership is ideal for 2 founders as it allows shared responsibility, resources, and decision-making while being easy to establish.
